title: [Meta] Nivesh PRD — feature & story tracking
body:
## Source
[`docs/Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap.md`](../blob/feature/mutual-fund-parity/docs/Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap.md)

## Purpose
Parent tracker for features and stories extracted from the Nivesh PRD (v1.0, 4 Nov 2026).

## Product pillars
- **Nivesh Research** — funds and companies
- **Nivesh Intelligence** — screeners, signals, AI
- **Nivesh Portfolio** — transactions, exposure, goals
- **Nivesh Trading** — broker / paper trading (later)

## Modules (epics)
- M01 Dashboard
- M02 Mutual Fund Research
- M03 Equity Research
- M04 Market Intelligence
- M05 Comparison engine
- M06 Screening engine
- M07 Portfolio management
- M08 Watchlists
- M09 Alerts and signals
- M10 AI research
- M11 Strategy Lab
- M12 Trading integration
- M13 Administration

## MVP workstreams
W1 Foundation → W2 MF data → W3 Equity data → W4 Analytics → W5 Research UI → W6 Discovery → W7 Quality/ops

## Priority legend
- **P0** MVP required
- **P1** Core expansion
- **P2** Advanced
- **P3** Later / compliance-dependent

Child issues are created for each feature ID and roadmap phase.

title: [Epic][M01] Dashboard
body:
## Objective
Provide a consolidated view of the market, portfolio and research activity.

## Stories
- Basic dashboard: major indices, portfolio summary when present, freshness/as-of
- Watchlist changes and recent alerts
- Recently viewed funds/stocks
- Corporate announcements strip
- Configurable widgets (P1)

## Priority
P0 basic dashboard; P1 configurable widgets.

## Source
PRD §4.1 M01

title: [M01][P0] Basic research dashboard
body:
## User story
As an investor, I want a home overview of markets and my research activity so I can decide what to investigate next.

## Requirements
- Major Indian index performance
- Portfolio value / invested / gains when a portfolio exists
- Asset allocation summary when portfolio exists
- Watchlist changes and recent alerts
- Recently viewed funds and stocks
- Data as-of dates and delayed/live status

## Acceptance
- Dashboard loads without requiring all widgets to have data
- Missing portfolio shows research/market widgets only
- Freshness visible for market figures

## Source
PRD §4.1, §5.1 Shared capabilities

title: [Epic][M02] Mutual Fund Research
body:
## Objective
End-to-end mutual fund research: master data, NAV, performance/risk, holdings, comparison, screener, detail page.

## Features
- MF-01 Scheme master (P0)
- MF-02 NAV history (P0)
- MF-03 Performance analytics (P0/P1)
- MF-04 Risk analytics (P0/P1)
- MF-05 Portfolio holdings (P1)
- MF-06 Fund overlap (P1)
- MF-07 Fund manager analysis (P1)
- MF-08 Fund comparison (P0/P1)
- MF-09 Fund screener (P0/P1)
- MF-10 Fund detail page (P0)

## Source
PRD §4.2

title: [M02][P0] MF-01 Scheme master
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I need a canonical scheme record so Direct/Regular and Growth/IDCW plans stay distinct and historically traceable.

## Requirements
Scheme code/identifiers, name, AMC, category/subcategory, plan/option, status, launch date, benchmark mappings with effective dates, manager assignments, AUM/TER/exit load/riskometer with as-of dates, source + last-updated.

## Rules
- Direct vs regular distinct
- Growth vs IDCW distinct
- Mergers/changes traceable
- Historical classifications/benchmarks not silently overwritten

## Acceptance
- Identity uniqueness enforced for plan/option combinations
- Benchmark mapping history retained

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-01

title: [M02][P0] MF-02 NAV history ingestion
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I need daily NAV history with provenance so performance metrics are reproducible.

## Requirements
- Daily NAV observations with source timestamps
- Duplicate / abnormal movement validation
- Missing expected observations detection
- Immutable raw NAVs; corrections via audit/version trail
- Distinguish non-business days from missing data

## Acceptance
- Historical NAV queryable by date range
- Failed ingestion retryable without duplicates

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-02, §5.3 AC1

title: [M02][P0] MF-03 Performance analytics (basic)
body:
## User story
As a fund investor, I want absolute returns, CAGR, rolling returns and benchmark outperformance for standard periods.

## MVP scope
Absolute return, CAGR, rolling returns (summary), benchmark returns/outperformance for 1M–10Y / since inception where meaningful.

## Later (P1)
Calendar/monthly returns, SIP XIRR, category average/median, return distribution, quartile ranking, rolling consistency charts.

## Acceptance
- Metrics reproducible from stored NAV
- Insufficient history → null + reason (never silent zero)
- Calculation version recorded

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-03, §5.1 Mutual funds

title: [M02][P0] MF-04 Risk analytics (core)
body:
## User story
As a fund investor, I want core risk metrics (volatility, Sharpe/Sortino, alpha/beta, max drawdown) with documented methodology.

## MVP metrics
Stdev, Sharpe, Sortino, beta, alpha, max drawdown.

## Later (P1)
R², current drawdown, downside deviation, up/down capture, Calmar, recovery duration.

## Acceptance
Every metric documents frequency, benchmark, risk-free rate, annualization, lookback, missing-obs treatment, calculation version.

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-04

title: [M02][P1] MF-05 Fund portfolio holdings
body:
## User story
As a fund investor, I want monthly portfolio disclosures so I can see concentration, sector mix and holding changes.

## Requirements
Top 10/20 holdings, sector & market-cap allocation, cash, new/exited/increased/reduced holdings, concentration/HHI, disclosure date + source.

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-05

title: [M02][P1] MF-06 Fund overlap analysis
body:
## User story
As a portfolio-oriented investor, I want overlap across schemes (and vs direct equities) so I can spot concentration.

## Requirements
Common securities, documented weighting method, common weights, sector overlap, consolidated exposure, stale disclosure warnings.

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-06

title: [M02][P1] MF-07 Fund manager analysis
body:
## User story
As a fund investor, I want manager tenure-aware performance so I do not attribute full scheme history to a recent manager.

## Requirements
Manager profile, assignment history with start/end, tenure-adjusted performance vs benchmark/category, risk-adjusted tenure metrics, change dates.

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-07

title: [M02][P0] MF-08 Fund comparison (basic)
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want to compare up to ~10 schemes on aligned dates for returns, risk, AUM, TER and benchmark.

## MVP
Returns, risk, AUM, TER, exit load, benchmark with aligned observation dates and comparable plan types.

## Later (P1)
Holdings, sector allocation, manager/tenure, concentration/overlap.

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-08, §5.1

title: [M02][P0] MF-09 Fund screener (basic)
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want configurable fund filters (category, AUM, returns, risk, TER, drawdown) and saved screens.

## MVP
Category/subcategory, AUM, returns, core risk, TER, drawdown filters; sort/rank; export optional.

## Later (P1)
Rolling consistency, manager tenure, portfolio characteristics, custom scoring.

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-09, §4.6

title: [M02][P0] MF-10 Fund detail page (core tabs)
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want a fund detail page with Overview, Performance, Risk, Benchmark/peers and freshness so I can complete a research pass.

## Core tabs (P0)
Overview, Performance, Risk, Benchmark and peers.

## Later tabs
Portfolio, Fund manager, Documents, AI research.

## Acceptance
Missing sections show unavailable + reason; metrics show as-of/source.

## Source
PRD §4.2 MF-10

title: [Epic][M03] Equity Research
body:
## Objective
Company master, market data, statements, fundamentals, valuation, technicals, ownership, governance, peers, detail page.

## Features
EQ-01…EQ-11 (see child stories).

## Source
PRD §4.3

title: [M03][P0] EQ-01 Company master
body:
## User story
As a stock researcher, I need a canonical company identity (NSE/BSE/ISIN, sector/industry, listing events).

## Requirements
Company name, NSE symbol, BSE code, ISIN, sector/industry, listing status/dates, mcap classification, identity event history (mergers, symbol changes, delistings).

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-01

title: [M03][P0] EQ-02 Daily market data (OHLCV)
body:
## User story
As a stock researcher, I need daily OHLCV and corporate-action-aware adjusted history with freshness metadata.

## Requirements
Daily OHLCV, adjusted history, corporate actions, index history, source/freshness. Intraday out of MVP.

## Acceptance
AC2/AC3: ingest+validate daily prices; corporate actions reflected in adjusted history.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-02, §5.3

title: [M03][P0] EQ-03 Financial statements ingestion
body:
## User story
As a stock researcher, I need annual/quarterly P&L, BS, CF with standalone vs consolidated kept distinct.

## Requirements
Annual/quarterly P&L, BS, CF; standalone & consolidated; TTM; restatements/versions; period end + publication date + source.

## Rules
Never mix standalone with consolidated in one calculation; never silently overwrite restatements.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-03, §6.4

title: [M03][P0] EQ-04 Fundamental analytics (core ratios)
body:
## User story
As a long-term equity investor, I want core profitability, growth, leverage and cash-flow ratios with definitions and trends.

## MVP
ROE/ROCE, margins, revenue/PAT/EPS growth, D/E, interest coverage, CFO/FCF basics.

## Later (P1)
Extended efficiency ratios and trend diagnostics.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-04

title: [M03][P0] EQ-05 Trailing valuation metrics
body:
## User story
As a stock researcher, I want trailing P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, dividend yield and mcap/EV with as-of context.

## Later (P1)
Historical valuation percentiles, peer comparison bands; forward only with licensed estimates.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-05

title: [M03][P1] EQ-06 DCF calculator
body:
## User story
As an advanced investor, I want a transparent DCF model with sensitivity (WACC / terminal growth) that is clearly a model, not fair value.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-06

title: [M03][P0] EQ-07 Technical charts and core indicators
body:
## User story
As an active investor, I want candlestick/line charts with volume and selected indicators (SMA/EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR).

## Later (P1)
Broader indicator set, candlestick pattern engine with historical evaluation.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-07

title: [M03][P1] EQ-08 Ownership / shareholding analysis
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want promoter/FII/DII/MF ownership, pledging and quarterly changes with reporting dates.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-08

title: [M03][P1] EQ-09 Governance and red flags
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want investigation flags (auditor changes, pledging, dilution, delayed filings, etc.) with source, date, severity and status — never auto-accusations.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-09

title: [M03][P1] EQ-10 Peer and sector analysis
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want sector-appropriate peer comparisons for growth, profitability, leverage, cash flow and valuation.

## Rule
Do not use one universal scoring model across banks, insurers, manufacturers and software.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-10

title: [M03][P0] EQ-11 Stock detail page (core sections)
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want a stock detail page covering overview, statements, fundamentals, valuation and technicals with freshness.

## Later tabs
Ownership, governance, peers, announcements, AI research.

## Source
PRD §4.3 EQ-11, §5.1

title: [Epic][M04] Market Intelligence
body:
## Objective
Indices, sector performance, breadth, macro, announcements — starting with major Indian indices and MF benchmarks.

## P0
Major index tracking + history needed for fund benchmarks (prefer TRI where appropriate).

## P1
Breadth (A/D, % above DMAs, 52w highs/lows), sector rotation, macro, news.

## Source
PRD §4.4, §6.3

title: [M04][P0] Major indices and benchmark history
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I need major Indian index history and scheme-benchmark mappings with effective dates for fair fund comparisons.

## Requirements
Index master (PRI/TRI classification), historical values, constituents with effective dates, scheme benchmark mappings, freshness.

## Rule
Do not compare dividend-inclusive fund returns to price-only indices without disclosure.

## Source
PRD §4.4, §6.3

title: [M04][P1] Market breadth and sector intelligence
body:
## User story
As an active investor, I want sector performance, advance/decline, % above key DMAs and 52-week extremes.

## Source
PRD §4.4

title: [Epic][M05] Comparison engine
body:
## Objective
Compare funds, stocks, investments vs benchmarks with aligned periods; later templates and saved comparisons.

## Source
PRD §4.5

title: [M05][P0] Basic comparison (fund/stock/benchmark)
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want side-by-side comparisons with aligned observation periods and configurable metrics.

## Acceptance
AC9: comparisons use aligned date ranges.

## Source
PRD §4.5, §5.3

title: [M05][P1] Comparison templates and saved comparisons
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want saved comparisons and templates (growth/value/quality/dividend/momentum/consistent MF/risk-adjusted MF).

## Source
PRD §4.5

title: [Epic][M06] Screening engine
body:
## Objective
Predefined + custom screens for equities and mutual funds; point-in-time backtests later.

## Source
PRD §4.6

title: [M06][P0] Basic multi-condition screener
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want AND/OR numeric and categorical filters with sort/rank and saved screens.

## Acceptance
AC10: screeners support multiple conditions.

## Source
PRD §4.6, §5.3

title: [M06][P1] Predefined screens and screen alerts
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want curated equity/MF screens and alerts when instruments enter/exit a screen.

## Source
PRD §4.6

title: [Epic][M07] Portfolio management
body:
## Objective
Multi-portfolio transactions, XIRR, allocation/exposure, rebalancing, goals — after research MVP.

## Source
PRD §4.7, Phase 3

title: [M07][P1] Portfolio transactions and holdings model
body:
## User story
As a portfolio investor, I want multiple portfolios with buys/sells, MF purchase/redemption, SIPs, dividends, splits/bonus, switches and opening balances.

## Acceptance
Portfolio value reconciles to holdings and transactions; corporate actions do not duplicate economic exposure.

## Source
PRD §4.7, Phase 3

title: [M07][P1] Portfolio analytics (XIRR, allocation, exposure)
body:
## User story
As a portfolio investor, I want invested/current value, XIRR, realized/unrealized gains, allocation, underlying MF exposure, drawdown and benchmark comparison.

## Source
PRD §4.7

title: [M07][P1] Goals, targets and rebalancing analysis
body:
## User story
As a portfolio investor, I want target allocations, rebalancing analysis, concentration alerts and goal tracking.

## Source
PRD §4.7

title: [Epic][M08] Watchlists
body:
## Objective
User-owned watchlists for funds and stocks with notes and thresholds.

## Source
PRD §4.8

title: [M08][P0] Basic multi-watchlists for funds and stocks
body:
## User story
As a researcher, I want multiple private watchlists with notes that persist across sessions.

## Acceptance
AC11: watchlists persist across sessions; user isolation (AC15).

## Source
PRD §4.8, §5.3

title: [Epic][M09] Alerts and signals
body:
## Objective
Versioned, explainable alerts across price, valuation, technicals, filings, fund changes and portfolio rules.

## Source
PRD §4.9

title: [M09][P1] Alert engine with versioned explainable rules
body:
## User story
As an investor, I want alerts that show the rule and values that triggered them, with in-app (and later email) delivery.

## Requirements
Record instrument, rule id/version, trigger values, timestamps, source data timestamp, expiry/invalidation, optional subsequent outcomes.

## Source
PRD §4.9

title: [Epic][M10] AI research
body:
## Objective
Evidence-based AI analysts (MF, equity, filings), thesis monitor and research reports — figures only from deterministic APIs.

## Source
PRD §4.10

title: [M10][P2] AI mutual fund and equity analysts
body:
## User story
As a research-oriented investor, I want AI summaries grounded in approved data tools with citations and uncertainty disclosure.

## Rules
AI must not invent values or replace tested financial calculations.

## Source
PRD §4.10

title: [M10][P2] Filing analyst, thesis monitor and research reports
body:
## User story
As an advanced investor, I want filing extraction with page references, thesis monitoring and structured research reports with limitations/as-of.

## Source
PRD §4.10

title: [Epic][M11] Strategy Lab
body:
## Objective
Point-in-time strategy builder and backtesting without look-ahead/survivorship bias.

## Source
PRD §4.11

title: [M11][P2] Point-in-time strategy backtesting
body:
## User story
As an advanced investor, I want rule-based backtests with costs, benchmark comparison and bias controls.

## Prevent
Look-ahead, survivorship, data snooping, unavailable-at-the-time financials, ignoring corporate actions/costs.

## Source
PRD §4.11

title: [Epic][M12] Trading integration
body:
## Objective
Isolated trading domain: paper trading first, then broker sandbox/live with explicit confirmation.

## Source
PRD §4.12; MVP non-goal for live trading

title: [M12][P3] Paper trading and broker sandbox
body:
## User story
As an advanced investor, I want paper orders with full lifecycle audit before live broker execution.

## Source
PRD §4.12, Phase 5

title: [Epic][M13] Administration and operations
body:
## Objective
Ingestion monitoring, data quality exceptions, methodology registry, auth/roles, audit, health.

## Source
PRD §4.13

title: [M13][P0] Ingestion monitoring and data quality ops
body:
## User story
As an operator, I want to monitor ingestion jobs, freshness and quality exceptions, and safely retry failures.

## Acceptance
AC12: failed ingestion jobs can be retried safely.

## Source
PRD §4.13, §6.5, §5.3

title: [M13][P0] Auth, user isolation and API foundation
body:
## User story
As a future multi-user product, I need authentication and user-owned data isolation from day one.

## Acceptance
AC15: user-owned data isolated between users.

## Source
PRD §5.1 Shared, W1 Foundation, principles §1.2

title: [M13][P0] Calculation methodology registry and versions
body:
## User story
As a researcher/operator, I need every displayed metric to expose methodology docs, as-of/source and calculation version.

## Acceptance
AC13/AC14: source/as-of context; calculation versions identifiable.

## Source
PRD §5.3, §7, §4.13

title: [Epic] Phase 0 — Product and data foundation
body:
## Deliverables
Confirm providers/rights, entity IDs, core schema, calculation methodology, API conventions, authz, FE/BE skeletons, ingestion framework, DQ checks, test infra.

## Exit criteria
Sample fund + stock end-to-end; raw sources retained; idempotent retries; calculation reproducible from stored inputs.

## Source
PRD §10 Phase 0, W1

title: [Epic] Phase 1 — Core research MVP
body:
## Deliverables
MF scheme+NAV, equity company+OHLC+statements, core MF/equity analytics, benchmarks, fund/stock detail, dashboard, basic comparison/screener, watchlists, ingestion monitoring.

## Exit criteria
End-to-end research workflows; reconciliation tests; visible freshness; missing ≠ zero.

## Source
PRD §10 Phase 1, §5, W2–W7

title: [Epic] Phase 2 — Advanced analytics
body:
## Deliverables
Rolling distributions, advanced risk, holdings, overlap, manager tenure, valuation bands, DCF, shareholding, governance flags, advanced technicals/patterns, peer/sector.

## Source
PRD §10 Phase 2

title: [Epic] Phase 3 — Portfolio management

Portfolio/TX model, corporate actions, XIRR, allocation/exposure, correlation/risk, rebalancing, goals.

PRD §10 Phase 3

title: [Epic] Phase 4 — Intelligence and AI

Alert engine, custom screens, filing ingestion, AI analysts/reports, thesis monitoring.

## Source
PRD §10 Phase 4

title: [Epic] Phase 5 — Strategy Lab and paper trading

Strategy builder, PIT backtests, costs, paper trading, broker sandbox.

## Source
PRD §10 Phase 5

title: [Epic] Phase 6 — Public launch and live trading readiness
body:

Public multi-user onboarding, permissions, metering/billing if needed, licence/security/regulatory readiness, live trading controls, production ops.

## Source
PRD §10 Phase 6

Deterministic, versioned calculations for MF and equity metrics with reconciliation tests.
